title: Megalopolis
body:
Inspired by the game mechanics of popular factory-genre games and the depth of kitchen sink packs, I present to you Megalopolis!

This pack incentivizes massive worlds and fast traversal speeds, combined with deep technological gameplay. It features the Immersive Railroading mod among many others, with the German Voxel Railroading resource pack.

Minimum hardware requirements:
- RAM: 16GB total (or 12GB free) DDR4-3600 or faster
- GPU: AMD RX 6800S (NVIDIA mobile RTX 4070) or faster
- CPU: AMD R5 7600 or faster
- SSD: NVMe PCIe 4.0 or faster

Ensure modpack instance is set to use Java 25 (and ignore compatibility checks if applicable).

Recommended hardware requirements:
- RAM: 16GB total (or 12GB free) DDR5 or faster
- GPU: AMD RX 9070 (NVIDIA RTX 5070) or faster
- CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D
- SSD: NVMe PCIe 4.0 or faster

This pack contains the C2ME OpenCL acceleration module. It does not gracefully disable itself if your hardware or driver is incompatible. Try disabling the mod if the game throws errors during world load.
